Diana remained in Essen until January 2009, when she left to join a skating centre in Halle. The story continues to revolve around the Steinkamp Sport and Wellness Centre and its quest to become a sporting powerhouse, as well as the lives of the characters who work at and around the Centre.

The National Dog Show has been ongoing since 1879 with its only interruption being the Great Depression from 1928 through 1932. The show is held by The Kennel Club of Philadelphia, a founding club of AKC. It traditionally takes place on the third from last weekend in November over two days. The National Dog show is one of the three major dog shows in the United States, along with the AKC/Eukanuba National Championship and the Westminster Dog Show. Winners may be invited to compete at Crufts. As with all AKC conformation shows, mixed-breed dogs are not eligible to participate. The show is nationally televised (on tape delay) in the United States on NBC every Thanksgiving; the show immediately follows the network's coverage of the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade and airs at noon in all time zones. releases.synopsis: Suidooster is a South African television soap opera produced by Suidooster Films which revolves around a matriarch, her family, friends and the people of Suidooster, a small shopping and business centre in the fictional Cape Town suburb of Ruiterbosch.

releases.title: Al Rojo Vivo
releases.synopsis: Al Rojo Vivo is a news magazine that in one hour, takes viewers on a journey through the world. It is an "information paella" that offers something for everyone: local and international news, entertainment, fashion, live interviews, special investigations, human interest, health, consumer alerts and new technology.

releases.title: Deal or No Deal
releases.synopsis: The iconic TV series Deal or No Deal is back but in a brand-new setting with brand-new prize boxes and a new batch of contestants hoping to win a whopping cash prize but who will have what it takes to beat our brand new Banker?

releases.title: Als de brandweer
releases.synopsis: Traffic accidents and resuscitation, but also elevator confinements, escaped animals and entrapments: the fire brigade does so much more than just extinguish fires. Als de brandweer shows the work of the Dutch fire department and shows what it is like to be in the shoes of these heroes when they head for an incident from a barracks. What starts in the emergency room with a frightened emergency call is given a follow-up if they get into the tanker syringe within one minute and blow out with screaming sirens. Never before have viewers come so close to the fire. They experience everything through the eyes of the firefighters, who portray their work themselves with different cameras.

A heist takes 12 months to plan, 12 hours to execute—and a thief not caught within 12 days won't be caught at all. Across three pulse-pounding timelines, an FBI agent and a career criminal face off in a deadly game of cat and mouse through Europe.

releases.title: 5 News at 5
releases.synopsis: National and international news.

releases.title: My Chef in Crime
releases.synopsis: Forensic scientist-turned-chef Chan becomes the prime suspect in his rival chef's mysterious death. He must clear his name, using his deep knowledge of food chemistry and forensic science, and teaming up with fearless investigative police officer Lieutenant Lalit whose past intertwines with his own. Together, they tackle intriguing cases through culinary experiments and create mouth-watering dishes.

releases.title: Eigyou Desukara
releases.synopsis: In order to be pampered by girls, Ren has been "Selling BL" (fanservice) by flirting with Issei, a handsome guy who attends the same college. But one day, Ren is suddenly kissed by Issei?!A fascinating love comedy that begins with a lie.

releases.title: Classic Movies: Iconic Scenes
releases.synopsis: Ian Nathan examines some of the most memorable scenes in the history of cinema.

releases.title: Steam Train Diaries
releases.synopsis: Paul 'Piglet' Middleton journeys through the picturesque North York Moors National Park onboard heritage steam engines, and discovers what it takes to keep this iconic line running.

releases.title: The Glory Fades
releases.synopsis: Su Yunian infiltrates the glittering, decadent world of "The Heart of Opulence" to uncover the truth behind her sister's death, only to be swept into a deadly power struggle between Nie Feng and Tu Jiasheng. She soon learns her sister was silenced for possessing crucial evidence. As danger mounts, betrayed by her closest friend, framed by the top courtesan, and relentlessly pursued by Nie Feng, Su Yunian walks a razor's edge between enmity and alliance with Tu Jiasheng. In this realm of illusions, every glimmer hides a blood-stained lie.

releases.title: Bakeskolen
releases.synopsis: 12 celebrity students will learn the art of baking with the help of the country's best chefs and pastry chefs. Who will emerge as the winner of the "Baking School" Golden Rolling Pin? Hosted by Eyvind Hellstrøm, Truls Svendsen, and Wenche Andersen.

releases.title: De Slimste Mens ter Wereld
releases.synopsis: Do we still sing the praises of folly like Erasmus, or is it trendy again to be smart? And if so, who is the smartest? Who can talk about the medals won at the Olympic Games in London, but at the same time knows who Captain Haddock is? Who knows whether Lacan was a hair growth product or a psychoanalyst and can also program their own digital television? Who has déjà vu when leafing through the Encyclopedia Britannica and when reading the interviews with the new Miss Waregem Koerse?  Who, oh who, is the smartest person in Flanders, Belgium, Europe, and by extension, the world? That is determined by a fierce battle between three fellow human beings. Every day, someone is eliminated, someone who may not be the smartest, but who is perhaps cherished in their family circle because of their many other talents. The others advance and are joined by a new challenger every day.

releases.title: SOKO Stuttgart
releases.synopsis: The SOKO Stuttgart team investigates analytically and with sensitivity in the likeable state capital. The exciting cases of the series lead them to bizarre crime scenes and to different milieus.

releases.title: CBS News 24/7
releases.synopsis: Live news and top stories on CBS News 24/7.

releases.title: Her Willing Subject
releases.synopsis: Regent Lu Qingcang and Empress Shen Shuying once divided the realm, ruler against ruler—yet the Yin-Yang Gu bound them to a shared fate of life and death. Manipulated by schemers, they perished together. Both reborn, they resume their bitter rivalry. Step by step, through political bloodshed and emotional tug-of-war, they unravel misunderstandings, learn to coexist and love, and join forces to break the game—transforming from hostile rivals into equals in love.

releases.title: Daughter of a Concubine
releases.synopsis: The blind girl rises up against the entire family!

releases.title: The Chemistry
releases.synopsis: Chemistry between characters is that special feeling that emerges when two people are together, making even the most ordinary moments feel extraordinary.

releases.title: Question Time
releases.synopsis: This topical debate series based on Any Questions? typically features politicians from at least the three major political parties as well as other public figures who answer pre-selected questions put to them by a carefully selected audience.

releases.title: ABC Prime with Linsey Davis
releases.synopsis: Providing prime-time context and analysis of the day's top stories, as well as in-depth reporting and storytelling from around the country and the globe.

releases.title: Hamburg Dockland
releases.synopsis: Shows the interaction between Hamburg police officers and paramedics.

releases.title: La promesa
releases.synopsis: In 1913 Spain, a woman gets a job at the palace of La Promesa as a reward for saving the marquesses' son - but nobody knows that she has her own plans, which involve avenging her mother's death and finding her missing brother.

releases.title: The Story Is with Elex Michaelson
releases.synopsis: The Story Is will feature live nightly panels and debates on set featuring a range of voices including attorneys Gloria Allred and Areva Martin, conservative talk radio hosts Larry Elder and Jennifer Horn, progressive podcast host Brian Tyler Cohen, former California GOP chair Jessica Millan Patterson and journalists Peter Hamby from Puck and POLITICO's Melanie Mason.

releases.title: An Là
releases.synopsis: National, international and local news from the BBC Alba team.

releases.title: Седьмой игрок
releases.synopsis: "Stroitel" club was once a successful team, and its owner dreamed of one day having the chance to move beyond its current league and earn a place in the KHL. But the players and coaching staff have fallen into a deep slump, leaving the team at the bottom of the standings with no way out. Now, it seems easier to shut down the club and its arena altogether. Losing faith in the team's chances of turning things around on the ice, "Stroitel's" owner appoints a figure skating coach as the club's director.The club's survival now depends on whether the former skater can unite the players, forge a bond between the team and its fans, who are considered the equivalent of a sixth player on the ice, and become the club's "seventh player" by finding success from behind the management desk.

releases.title: Still a Family
releases.synopsis: In 2008, with China's economy booming, the Sai Duoxi family living on the Jiaodong Peninsula undergoes a dramatic change. A large demolition compensation payment puts the family's old troubles and chronic problems on full display. Sai Duoxi, a domineering and authoritarian father, throws his children's lives into chaos as he fights to preserve his rule over the household. The five pairs of sons and daughters in the Sai family are five different portraits of life. A sudden turn of events then shakes Sai Duoxi's status as "head of the family," while the five pairs of children begin to reconsider the family's generational relationships and confront their own life dilemmas. Ultimately, the Sai family comes to understand that a home is a place of equality and dignity, and that love means family reunion.

releases.title: ABC News Live
releases.synopsis: ABC News Live will bring streaming viewers the latest headlines, compelling stories, interviews and roundtable discussions.

releases.title: America Reports
releases.synopsis: A look at the latest news and headlines with Sandra Smith and John Roberts

releases.title: American Agenda
releases.synopsis: American Agenda with hosts Bob Brooks & Katrina Szish is a live, fast-paced look at national news and international events. The program brings viewers the latest from Washington, with insightful analysis from lawmakers and experts, and media reports from New York and around the globe.

releases.title: Горнолыжка
releases.synopsis: Reliable and fair, Misha has worked as a crane operator at the port in the small provincial town of Zavodskoy all his life. When the port owner once again fails to pay his workers, Misha stands up for his colleagues – and naturally ends up without a job. Misha is burdened by his lazy son, Timur – a carefree adventurer who never misses an opportunity to make easy money, but every time he fails and accumulates debts. Trying to stay afloat, Misha miraculously gets a job at an elite ski resort. Everything here is arranged in a strict order: team discipline, a schedule, different personalities, and a multitude of tasks that need to be handled on the fly – from everyday little things to conflicts with inspectors and sometimes with guests. The resort is run by a demanding yet caring Katya, for whom Misha gradually develops feelings. The only problem is that Katya is in a serious relationship – and not just with anyone, but with Denis, the owner of the very port where Misha used to work. This is how a love triangle is formed, turning every day at the resort into a series of force majeure situations, where not only the characters' personal happiness is at risk, but also the smooth operation of the entire ski resort.

releases.title: Natural High
releases.synopsis: Come and join Shen Teng and his friends as they step away from the bustling crowded cities and reconnect with the beautiful wild nature.

releases.title: Сталин
releases.synopsis: The end of the Great Patriotic War, the beginning of the Cold war with the West, the nuclear race and the struggle for power in closed cabinets — how were the decisions that determined the course of world history actually made? The secret details of the last years of the life of one of the most controversial politicians of the 20th century.

releases.title: Paskong Pinoy
releases.synopsis: A reunion in Boracay, an office romance, mistaken identities and feuding sisters — four stories that capture love, family and a Filipino Christmas.

releases.title: Al Fondo Hay Sitio
releases.synopsis:
One of Lima’s most exclusive residential neighborhoods is turned upside down by the arrival of the Gonzales family, who have come from the countryside to settle into a half-finished house they inherited. Their down-to-earth ways will rub the neighbors the wrong way, especially the Maldinis, who will do everything in their power to get rid of them.

As the years go by and new seasons unfold, the story deepens with the arrival of the Montalván family, who will bring even more conflicts and unexpected situations to this unique neighborhood.

releases.title: Dreams of Freedom
releases.synopsis: Begoña Montes is a woman who lives trapped in a toxic marriage and seeks the long-awaited freedom in Spain in 1958.

releases.title: ABC News Live First
releases.synopsis: ABC News Live First will bring streaming viewers the latest headlines, compelling stories, interviews and roundtable discussions.

releases.title: ABC News Live Reports
releases.synopsis: ABC News Live Reports is the rare national newscast based in Los Angeles, in what the network is billing as an "outside the Beltway" focus on politics for the 2024 election cycle.

releases.title: The Story Untold
releases.synopsis: Adapted from Twentine's novel The Story Untold, the drama follows Yang Zhao, an art restorer haunted by childhood trauma. She has long believed that her emotional wounds will never heal, until she meets Chen Mingsheng, a narcotics officer working undercover in Bai Ji's drug trafficking organization. Their encounter profoundly affects them both, but when his mission goes wrong, Chen Mingsheng is forced to disappear from Yang Zhao's life. Their abruptly interrupted relationship leaves an indelible mark on her heart. Three years later, Yang Zhao unexpectedly reunites with Chen Mingsheng in another city. Having lost a leg, he now lives an unassuming life as a taxi driver. Determined never to let him go again, Yang Zhao finally opens up to him, revealing her true self and allowing him into her world. However, during a trip, Chen Mingsheng's identity is exposed, forcing him to return to the front lines of the fight against drug trafficking. The two promise never to be separated again once his mission is complete. Yet when Yang Zhao finally receives news of Chen Mingsheng, she rushes to the hospital, only to find him fighting for his life. As she watches helplessly, she has no idea what fate has in store for them...

releases.title: Silent Echoes
releases.synopsis: In 2011, a murder case occurs at Jiugu Lake in Xiping City. Detective Ma Xuesong and rookie female officer Meng Wen begin investigating and discover the case is linked to the disappearance of Luo Xue, involving multiple parties including the Deli Group. As more murders surface, a criminal network involving drugs, money laundering, and abuse gradually comes to light. Throughout the investigation, the two draw closer to the truth while each undergoes their own growth and trials.

releases.title: Amanpour & Co.
releases.synopsis: Featuring conversations with global leaders and decision makers on the issues affecting the world today, Amanpour and Company adds to the long tradition of public affairs programming that has been a hallmark of public media for decades.

releases.title: 5 News at 19:55
releases.synopsis: National and international news

releases.title: Las Fierbinti
releases.synopsis: "Las Fierbinti" is a Romanian drama-comedy series set in a fictional small village, where everyday life, local politics, and village gossip turn into humor and chaos.

releases.title: Pushpa Impossible
releases.synopsis: Pushpa Impossible is the story about a feisty middle-aged woman having studied until grade 9 in a Gujarati medium school and going back to school at the age of 44! She is boisterous, uncouth, impulsive, hardworking and an endearingly loveable mother of three children. She is Pushpa Patel hailing from a small town Patan in Gujarat and now residing at Bapodra Chawl in Mumbai. The show is a peek into her day-to-day struggles, her small victories, her Juggad, her shortcomings, and her constant pursuit of living a good life while struggling as a full-time mother and part-time businesswoman. The show is an autobiography of a mother, who decides to go back to school and change her life by impacting many lives!

releases.title: Dongda Gao Wu Xueyuan
releases.synopsis: In a city experiencing a spiritual resurgence, demons threaten to invade. Qin Yu, a boy born with a useless spiritual root, unexpectedly awakens divine power within him and is chosen to inherit the mysterious and powerful cultivation technique, "The Life-Giving Power of All Things." After joining the Dongda Martial Arts Academy, Qin Yu gradually befriends a group of chivalrous companions, cultivating and growing together to protect their school and their planet .

releases.title: Çiçekçi Kız
releases.synopsis: The story revolves around two completely opposite people whose paths unexpectedly cross in a small boutique flower cafe.

releases.title: Days of Our Lives
releases.synopsis: The Horton and Brady broods endure the romantic trials of life in Salem, a Midwestern hamlet filled with evil geniuses, star-crossed lovers and a rich family history.

releases.title: The Arena with Kasie Hunt
releases.synopsis: Kasie Hunt brings key players into the arena for sharp analysis and panel discussion on the latest news in politics and culture.

releases.title: Wheel of Fortune
releases.synopsis: This game show sees contestants solve word puzzles, similar to those used in Hangman, to win cash and prizes determined by spinning a giant carnival wheel.

releases.title: Anupamaa
releases.synopsis: Anupama had to sacrifice a lot to become an ideal wife, daughter-in-law, and mother. After a bitter realisation, she sets out to live on her own terms.

releases.synopsis: National and international news.

releases.title: TNA iMPACT!
releases.synopsis: TNA iMPACT offers a unique style of wrestling that features a blend of the traditional with high-flying athleticism and cutting edge action. TNA's roster includes the biggest names in wrestling today, and the hottest new stars in the sport.

releases.title: 10's Late News
releases.synopsis: Ursula Heger, a senior journalist at 10 News First, will anchor the newly reintroduced news bulletin. Having been with the network since 2011, Heger has covered significant events, including the Ukraine conflict, the demise of Queen Elizabeth II, and other critical global stories.Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

releases.title: House of Games
releases.synopsis: Each week a group of four famous faces go toe to toe in testing their general knowledge skills in a variety of entertaining games.

releases.title: All Elite Wrestling: Collision
releases.synopsis: An in-ring show featuring more wrestlers, more stories and more action to super-serve fans.

releases.title: Plus belle la vie, encore plus belle
KBS Drama Special
releases.synopsis: Forget the existing one-act dramas! Short but impactive! KBS Drama Special presents high quality single episode dramas. Dramas are the broadcast content with the widest public appeal. KBS Drama Special will produce short dramas of far-reaching impact involving at times a serious social message, unique emotions or perspectives. It will stay abreast of modern viewership.

releases.title: Big Brother
releases.synopsis: Big Brother is an Australian reality show based on the international Big Brother format created by John de Mol. Following the premise of other versions of the format, the show features a group of contestants, known as "housemates" who live together in a specially constructed house that is isolated from the outside world. The housemates are continuously monitored during their stay in the house by live television cameras as well as personal audio microphones. Throughout the course of the competition, housemates are evicted from the house - eliminated from the competition. The last remaining housemate wins the competition and is awarded a cash prize.

releases.title: Flower girl
releases.synopsis: The series "The Flower Girl"—starring Helin Kandemir as Nilüfer and Hakan Çelebi as Faruk—tells the story of Nilüfer, who opens a flower shop to pursue her dreams, and Faruk, a police officer working on a secret assignment. When their paths cross, it sets off a series of unexpected events. By bringing two contrasting characters together in a single shop, the series blends romantic comedy with elements of crime and detective fiction.

releases.title: TMZ
releases.synopsis: Based on the popular gossip website, this entertainment newsmagazine delivers daily updates on Hollywood's rich, beautiful and screwed-up. The program often shows highlights of the day's staff meeting during which reporters pitch ideas for stories to air that day.

releases.title: Le Tricheur
releases.synopsis: This daily quiz show puts strategy front and centre, as five celebrities answer general-knowledge questions to win money for their favourite charity. But here’s the catch: one of the five participants is cheating, because they’re secretly being fed the answers. The cheater’s mission is to play it smart so they can fool the other players and win the game without getting caught.

releases.title: Fair City
releases.synopsis: The day-to-day dramas of the community who live and work in the fictional north Dublin suburb of Carrigstown.

releases.title: A Fazenda
releases.synopsis:
A Fazenda is the current Brazilian version of the The Farm reality television show based on the Swedish television series of the same name that was originally created in 2001 by Strix and produced in association with Sony Entertainment and Endemol.

The show is based on a group of celebrities living together twenty-four hours a day in a Farm, isolated from the outside world while having all their steps followed by cameras around-the-clock, with no privacy for three months.

The contestants compete for the chance to win the grand prize by avoiding weekly eviction, until the last celebrity remains at the end of the season that can claim the grand prize. The show is presented by news reporter Britto Junior alongside actress Chris Couto and directed by Rodrigo Carelli. Record's website and a Record-owned pay-per-view channel offer round-the-clock coverage.

releases.title: Familie
releases.synopsis: 'Familie' is the longest running Belgian soap opera. The Van den Bossches originally had an electronics company, later a holding company that included a clothing chain and a sandwich shop. In the meantime, we closely follow the personal lives of the Van den Bossches and their entourage. Grandma Anna and all her children and grandchildren have been through a lot over time and it doesn't look like their lives will become calmer any time soon.

releases.title: Ville fristelser
releases.synopsis: Ten Norwegians fight against both the wild jungle and their own impulses when wild temptations distract them from their goal - a prize pool of 2.5 million kroner.

releases.title: Amanpour
releases.synopsis: Amanpour is CNN International's flagship global affairs interview program hosted by Chief International Correspondent Christiane Amanpour.

releases.title: Babel
releases.synopsis: Babel is your reading lamp in life. Jessika Gedin meets the most read and interesting authors right now and the author panel talks life and reading.

releases.title: Nurses
releases.synopsis: Like good soldiers in a war-zone, hospital staff are expected to respect the chain of command when dealing with life and death situations. But what happens when smug doctors, arrogant surgeons, and out-of-touch administrators make that easier said than done? Nurses deals with the professional and personal lives of four female colleagues who cope in different ways with the challenges of life on the trauma ward. With determination, strength, and a dark sense of humor, they achieve the demanding and inspiring task of saving lives in a system that sometimes seems designed to do the opposite.

releases.title: The Alliance
releases.synopsis:
In the show, participants form teams to earn as many points as possible during games and challenges.

Any contestant on the winning team at the end of the month stands a chance of winning €100,000, but there can only be one ultimate winner of this prize; ultimately, they must compete against one another. Participants on the worst-performing team at the end of the month risk being sent home empty-handed. Consequently, two contestants are eliminated each month, but two new faces join the group to replace them.

releases.title: Dahoam is Dahoam
releases.synopsis: The lives of the residents of the fictitious village of Lansing in Upper Bavaria.

releases.title: The Bride
releases.synopsis: The continuation of the lineage of a deep-rooted family depends on Cihan Develioğlu's unborn son, but Cihan cannot have a child due to his wife. Mukadder plays a cruel game for her son Cihan to have a son. Mukadder goes to Cihan's wife, Beyza, with a dangerous proposal and asks her to divorce her son. Named after her sharp looks, Hançer faces an offer that will turn her life upside down. Mukadder, who takes advantage of the fact that Hançer is poor and has a family that will not cause trouble, offers her the opportunity to marry her son and give birth to a male child. Hançer, who dreams of finding the love of her life and having a happy marriage, first rejects this offer. However, she is forced to accept the offer when she learns that her brother has a deadly illness. Cihan and Hançer, who have entered an irreversible path, will no longer be the same. Will these two young people, drawn into a big game and lost in a dark maze, fall under the spell of love contrary to the planned games?

releases.title: The Kardashians
releases.synopsis: The family you know and love is here with a brand new series, giving an all-access pass into their lives. Kris, Kourtney, Kim, Khloé, Kendall, and Kylie bring the cameras back to reveal the truth behind the headlines. From the intense pressures of running billion-dollar businesses to the hilarious joys of playtime and school drop-offs, this series brings viewers into the fold with a rivetingly honest story of love & life in the spotlight.

releases.title: Father Matthew
releases.synopsis: Father Matthew is about the adventures of a Roman Catholic priest who, after returning from a mission to Belarus, is sent to work in a small parish. As a pastor, together with a friendly policeman, he solves mysteries and gives help to his parishioners, as well as all those who are in need.

releases.title: To Love Is To Care
releases.synopsis: After a devastating flood leaves her with nothing, physiotherapist Adriana finds work as a caregiver for Arthur Brandão, a reclusive jewelry tycoon surrounded by ambitious heirs. The trust that develops between them leads to a marriage of convenience designed to protect Arthur’s legacy, but the arrangement turns tragic when he is murdered on their wedding night.​ Wrongfully convicted of the crime, Adriana spends six years in prison, losing her identity and her future.​Now free, she embarks on an intense journey of revenge and justice to unmask the real killer, reclaim her life, and confront a forbidden love from her past.

releases.title: Kaun Banega Crorepati
releases.synopsis: Hosted by India's biggest superstar, Amitabh Bachchan, one of the biggest shows is here to entertain millions, change lives and make dreams come true.

releases.title: All Against All
releases.synopsis: Who are the most knowledgeable celebrities Norway has to offer? Well-known Norwegians face off in a tough and entertaining battle of brains.

releases.title: Star Academy
releases.synopsis: Star Academy is a French reality television show produced by the Dutch company Endemol. It consists of a contest of young singers. It spawned an equally successful show in Quebec called Star Académie. It is broadcast on TF1. At the end of each season, selected contestants would go on tour around France, Morocco, Switzerland, Belgium, Tunisia, and other French-speaking countries.

releases.title: Heart Beat
releases.synopsis: RK Multispeciality Hospital is a beacon of hope and healing. Its doctors are resilient even when they have to deal with medical and personal challenges.

releases.title: X Factor
releases.synopsis: X Factor is the Italian version of the British musical talent show The X Factor. The first four seasons aired on Rai 2, but since 2011 it has been broadcast on Sky Uno, with reruns on TV8, after Rai dropped the show due to high costs. Sky Italia acquired the format, extending its broadcast until 2024. Starting from the eleventh season, RTL 102.5 became the official radio station, replacing Radio Deejay and Radio 105. The show was hosted by Francesco Facchinetti (2008-2010), Alessandro Cattelan (2011-2020), Ludovico Tersigni (2021), and Francesca Michielin (2022-2023). From 2024 onwards, Giorgia will take over as host. Since the seventh season, the show has been produced by Fremantle Italia without the collaboration of Magnolia, which had produced the selection episodes in the early seasons.

releases.title: Dragons' Den
releases.synopsis: Canadian version of the reality show in which budding entrepreneurs pitch their business ideas to a panel of venture capitalists in the hopes of securing business financing.

releases.title: Die Bergretter
releases.synopsis: Die Bergwacht is a German mountain rescue television series, broadcast since 26 November, 2009 on ZDF.

releases.title: Vandaag Inside
releases.synopsis: Vandaag Inside is a late-night talk show that airs on SBS6 in the Netherlands. It's known for its lively discussions, often revolving around current events, politics, and social issues, but with a bit of humor and controversy mixed in. The program has a unique dynamic because it features a combination of light-hearted banter and in-depth discussions about more serious topics.

releases.title: Homes Under the Hammer
releases.synopsis: Homes Under the Hammer is a British renovation and auction series that originally screened on BBC One as part of the BBC's morning television schedule, the series has been running since 2003. Its main presenters are Lucy Alexander and Martin Roberts, although in series three Marc Woodward and Jasmine Birtles alternated presenting duties with Alexander and Roberts. The series is the BBC's most successful show in the 10:00am slot, regularly attaining a 30% market share for new episodes.

releases.title: Blossom in Darkness
releases.synopsis: Qi Fengyin, a feared demon lord blamed for all evil, encounters Ya Mao, a girl whose flesh is coveted for its extraordinary powers. Forced into a bond, the two clash yet gradually become each other's salvation. Together, they unravel six bizarre mysteries involving deadly curses, demons, resurrection, and forbidden love. As they expose a hidden conspiracy, they clear their names, free the world from its shackles, and give lovers a chance to stay together.

releases.title: River of No Return
releases.synopsis: In the Ming Dynasty, Crown Prince Zhu Zhanji races 2,200 miles from Nanjing to Beijing in 15 days to save himself and the empire.

releases.title: Valle salvaje
releases.synopsis: 1763. The life of Adriana, a brave and loyal woman, suffers an unexpected setback when she receives a devastating blow: her father has died, and, as a result of a secret pact, she must travel from the city of Madrid to Valle Salvaje, in northern Spain, to marry a stranger. A dark secret from her past follows her to the remote valley, home to her fiancé's family and her troubled aunt, Doña Victoria. There, her life will change forever. She will experience true love, betrayal, and danger as she tries to uncover the truth behind her father's death.

releases.title: Reincarnated as a Sword
releases.synopsis: Reincarnated as a sentient weapon with memories of his past life, but not his name, a magical sword saves a young beastgirl from a life of slavery. Fran, the cat-eared girl, becomes his wielder, and wants only to grow stronger, while the sword wants to know why he is here. Together, the strange duo's journey has only just begun!

releases.title: Extra 3
releases.synopsis: Extra 3 is a political satirical magazine from Norddeutscher Rundfunk (NDR).

releases.title: Mein Lokal, Dein Lokal
releases.synopsis: Each week five restaurant chefs from a different city compete against each other - while the restaurant is running and with an à la carte order! The winner receives 5,000 euros and the “Mein Lokal, Dein Lokal” award!

releases.title: Jade Dynasty
releases.synopsis: Zhang Xiaofan, who turned into an orphan overnight, becomes a disciple of the Qingyun Sect. After five years of training, he performs well in the Seven Peak Martial Arts Competition. He's sent to the Kongsang Mountain to defeat the evil. During the journey, he and his senior, Lu Xueqi, met with an accident, and got to know and save the lady of the cult, Bi Yao. At the same time, new danger is ahead of him.

**A trans woman discovers pornography of herself she has no memory of making, only to find herself led to an unimaginably deeper evil.**

A feral shut-in discovers a disturbing internet porn video of what seems to be herself. A seance of coked-up artists summons unearthly forces in a studio apartment. The staircase of an exurban marketing company descends endlessly beneath the earth. 

In Aoife Josie Clements’ electric, nightmarish, intricately layered novel, the impossibility of goodness crowds in upon two young trans women barely surviving on sex work and zero-hours contracts. Below the familiar evils of capitalism and the bottomless depths of internet culture, a darker horror awaits. What curse follows these women? What are they escaping? What are they running towards?

releases.title: The Escape Game
releases.synopsis:
**It’s all fun and games until someone ends up dead.**

Six months ago, season four of The Escape Game ended in horror when contestant Alicia Angelos was found murdered on set.

Now season five is underway, and new contestants are ready to put their skills to the test solving the show's trickiest escape rooms. There's Adi, the cryptographer; Carter, the math whiz; Beck, the wannabe game master; and . . . Sierra Angelos, the girl who got away with her sister’s murder. Or so everyone believes.

But Sierra’s not just here to win. She’s here for justice.

When the contestants begin uncovering clues that hint at the identity of Alicia’s true killer, it becomes clear that the stakes aren’t high just in this competition—they’re deadly. If these teens want to win—and survive—the game, they must solve the biggest mystery of all: who killed Alicia Angelos?

releases.title: The Radiant Dark
releases.synopsis:
***Arrival meets Wild Dark Shore in this captivating novel that follows a family for over fifty years—a bold and compassionate exploration of the universe around us and what it truly means to be human.***

It’s March 1980, and Carol Girard and her husband are living an ordinary life in a small town in the Adirondacks. They have just had their first child, and though Carol is struggling with the challenges of new motherhood, her future seems clear. Until something extraordinary happens: an inexplicable flickering of light in the sky, which is ultimately determined to be communication from intelligent life on another planet. But these beings are eleven light-years away, and nothing is known about them other than the fact that they seem to know we exist too. And so begins a decades-long exchange of messages with this mysterious, faraway civilization.

As humanity reels from a shifting understanding of its place in the universe, we follow the stories of the Girard family: Carol, whose fascination with this other life sparks a desperate search for spiritual meaning; Michael, her loyal son, who finds solace not in the stars above his head but in the ground beneath his feet; and Ro, Carol’s bright and ambitious daughter, whose childhood goal to work in interstellar communication will evolve into something far grander.

Tracing five decades of love, loss, ambition, and self-discovery, *The Radiant Dark* is a stunning examination of a family navigating their lives with the knowledge that we are not alone.

releases.synopsis:
Wings of Brotherhood: A Journey Between Two Air Forces by Badrul Hassan Khan is an extraordinary Pakistan Air Force memoir that takes readers inside the cockpit, command rooms, and corridors of power across South Asia and the Gulf. From fierce dogfights in West Pakistan during the 1965 war to the heartbreaking betrayals of 1971, this PAF pilot biography book reveals the courage, loyalty, and sacrifices of men who shaped aerial warfare in the region.

Wing Commander Badrul Hassan Khan, one of the rare officers to have fought in both the Indo Pak wars, offers an unfiltered look at how politics, pride, and patriotism collided in the skies. As he moves from the Pakistan Air Force to help build Bahrain’s Air Wing from scratch, readers witness the remarkable evolution of two nations’ military identities.

Packed with gripping battle scenes, behind the scenes accounts of Air Marshal Noor Khan’s leadership, and insider perspectives on military intelligence, this military memoir book captures a defining era of aviation and regional geopolitics. Whether you’re a history enthusiast, a student of Pakistan Air Force history, or simply drawn to tales of valor and vision, Wings of Brotherhood offers an unmatched journey through war, duty, and brotherhood.

A powerful addition to collections of books on the Indo Pak war 1965 and 1971, this is the definitive Pakistan Air Force memoir, a story of ambition, betrayal, and resilience that continues to shape South Asia’s skies.

A lifelong educator, Ms. Opal has been a community activist all her life, and would take on the movement to celebrate and commemorate Juneteenth not just as a holiday, but as a symbol of comprehensive freedom for all people.

Ms. Opal’s life personifies the fight for everyday freedom that leads to lasting change. As the Grandmother of Juneteenth says, “There is so much more to do.”

releases.synopsis:
**A timely call for Texas--and the South--to reclaim its radical history, drawing lessons for today's struggle from the populists and socialists of yesteryear.**

In blood-red states such as Texas, politics operates under the fallacy that these places were always conservative, so that it would be foolish, even utopian, to propose a progressive alternative. *The Myth of Red Texas*, David Griscom's debut book, reassesses this misconception, arguing that the Lone Star Left must embrace its hidden past to reach a brighter future.

Cowboys on strike, socialists on the ballot, farmers fighting tooth and claw for what they termed the "cooperative commonwealth"--Texas was once a wellspring of radicals hell-bent on taking power from the robber barons who ruled the day. With a careful eye for history, Griscom demonstrates how Texans' left-wing parties, from the populists to the socialists, organized against the Right and often won--and how reclaiming that tradition can help today's Left break the political deadlock in Texas and beyond.

releases.title: Selecting and Appraising Archives and Manuscripts
releases.synopsis:
Today, we operate in an environment of records abundance, with far more documentation created than can reasonably be kept. Thoughtful selection and appraisal is both a balancing act and a vital skill for modern archivists. Selecting and Appraising Archives and Manuscripts is a concise introduction to the theory and practice of archival selection and appraisal, offering practical tools for principled work.

While much of the existing literature on appraisal is theoretical, this book focuses on practical ideas that are grounded in best practices, informed by the past, and aspirationally moving the profession forward. Divided into six chapters, topics include policy development, ethics and strategies for collecting repositories, tools and methods for analyzing records, appraisal and acquisition in institutional settings, and more. Guidance is centered on intentional collecting, adherence to professional values, and responsible stewardship, and covers a variety of formats.

This volume can be read in a linear way or used as a quick reference in real-life scenarios. Read it in its entirety, or jump to specific chapters as your situation warrants. This volume will help readers feel confident in making thoughtful collection- building decisions.

The author captures both the cruelty of power and the quiet strength of hope, allowing the reader to see how art can express what words often cannot. releases.title: Ubay

She lands in the remote White Mountains of Crete, expecting to remain invisible. Instead, an elderly couple finds her, feeds her, and gives her work in their family taverna. As she works, she files meticulous reports on human behaviour, from inexplicable kindness to stubborn hope. But the observer is changing. When her identity is threatened, Ubay must choose between completing her mission and protecting the family who taught her what it means to care. This is a quiet, philosophical first-contact story about belonging, empathy, and the limits of logic, and it is the third volume in a trilogy that includes Ari's Taverna and Unheard Voice.*

releases.title: Whidbey
releases.synopsis:
Birdie Chang didn’t know anything about Whidbey Island when she chose it, only that it was about as far away as she could get from her own life. She’s a woman on the run, desperate for an escape from the headlines back home and the look of concern in her girlfriend’s eyes—and from Calvin Boyer, the man who abused her as a child and who’s now resurfaced. On her way, she has an unnerving encounter with a stranger on the ferry who offers her a proposition, a sinister solution, a plan for revenge.

But Birdie isn’t the only girl Calvin harmed back then. There’s also Linzie King, a former reality TV star who recently wrote all about it in her bestselling memoir. Though the two women have never met, their stories intertwine. Once Birdie arrives on Whidbey, she finally cracks the book’s spine, only to find too much she recognizes in its pages. Soon after, on the other side of the country, Calvin’s loving mother, Mary-Beth, receives a shocking phone call from the police: her only son has been murdered.

Calvin’s death sets into motion a series of events that sends each woman on a desperate search for answers. A complex whodunnit told from alternating points of view, Whidbey is searingly perceptive and astonishingly original. Exploring the long reach of violence and our flawed systems of incarceration and rehabilitation, this is a tense and provocative debut that’s sure to incite crucial questions about the pursuit of justice and who has real power over a story: the one who lives it, or the one who tells it?

releases.title: Night Night Fawn

She has opinions about her smutty late husband, her career as the receptionist for a disreputable plastic surgeon, her glory days as an accomplished jazzerciser, and her failed aspirations to be a film noir actress. But what she really wants to talk about are unhinged thoughts on gender, Karl Marx, Zionism, and her two great disappointing loves: an estranged trans son and a long-lost best friend whose betrayal haunts Barbara still. As she descends further into delirium and illness, Barbara finds herself in a nightmare from which she cannot escape, and her circumstances put her on a crash course with these intimates—or are they avenging nemeses?—once again.

releases.title: Conscious and Conflict | Young Adult Prose Poetry Book
releases.synopsis:
Conscious and Conflict is a powerful combination of a young adult poetry book and short stories that brings to life the fears, doubts, and aspirations of adolescent voices shaped by the Covid-19 pandemic. Through emotionally resonant writing, the author presents a compelling poetry book for youth that reflects uncertainty and the search for identity during a deeply transformative time.

Blending lyrical expression with reflection, this prose poetry book explores how young people perceive the world and respond to inequality, emotional isolation, and the everyday conflicts of growing up. The collection also carries elements of a political poetry book, subtly addressing social injustice, awareness, and resistance through the lens of youth.

This collection is a must-read for readers looking for a modern poems collection or a contemporary short stories book, or poetry that offers honest and intimate snapshots of young minds living in this evolving era.

releases.synopsis:
*“If we stay here, if we keep wandering without a real plan, we won’t last. Maybe The Hill is dangerous. But maybe it’s not. It’s the only plan we have.”*

Seventeen-year-old Aurora knows how to survive. Life in the foster system has taught her how to stay quiet, stay smart, and stay ready. But nothing could prepare her for this: a never-ending storm that swallows cities, drowns forests, and turns the world into a flooded wasteland.

Trapped in a collapsing house with her strict prepper foster parents, Aurora is forced to live by their rules just to stay alive. Until the day they disappear without a trace.

**Alone. Abandoned.** And **running out of time.**

All Aurora has is a waterlogged scrap of paper and a “The Hill.”

With looters closing in and the floodwaters rising higher each day, she’s left with **one impossible choice**—stay and wait for the storm to take her, or risk everything on a journey through the drowned remains of the world, to a find a place that may or not exist.

It’s forward or nothing.
